components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The owner's optional honorific title (one of MR, MRS, MS, DR). When supplied it is
            combined with the last name to compose the read-only 'salutation'.
          type: string
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility; when the
            structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred. On read this is the composed,
            normalized address: the normalized 'addressLine1' with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when 'addressLine2' is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address' when
            present. Normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common street types expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address (e.g. unit or apartment).
            Normalized the same way as 'addressLine1' and appended to the composed 'address' when
            present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-+()0-9 ]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address. It is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's postal code. Optional; when present it must be exactly 4 digits and
            valid for the city's region (Sydney=NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne=VIC 3000-3099,
            Brisbane=QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
            Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when present it is
            used to derive the owner's ageBand against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-time flag. The householdId is deterministic from (lastName, postcode), so owners
            with the same last name and postcode are already the same household. A second owner in an
            existing household is normally rejected as a household duplicate (409); setting this flag
            true only bypasses that block, declaring the owner an intentional household member. A
            declared member is created and is not flagged as a possibleDuplicate. Write-only; never
            returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true

## What I implemented

`riskFlag` is a derived, read-only boolean on the owner response, true when **any** of the three conditions hold, else false. I followed the codebase's established pattern for computed read-only DTO fields (`locality`, `membershipLevel`, `ownerSegment`, …): a `util` class invoked from a mapstruct `expression` mapping — no entity field, no pipeline step, no schema/DB change. Because it's derived from already-computed state, it's identical on the create response and on later `GET`s.

The three conditions map to existing concepts:

- **possible duplicate** → `owner.getPossibleDuplicate()` (set by `CheckPossibleDuplicate`).
- **city over soft capacity** → `owner.getCapacityWarning()` — the existing soft per-city band (40–49, below the hard cap of 50 which rejects the create).
- **email domain disposable-adjacent** → a domain that is a sub-domain of a throwaway provider (e.g. `signup.mailinator.com`). Exact disposable domains are already rejected with 400 at validation, so they never reach a persisted owner; the adjacency check flags the near-misses that slip through.

Files:
- `util/DisposableEmailDomains.java` (new) — the single disposable-domain blocklist plus `isBlocked` (exact) and `isDisposableAdjacent` (domain or sub-domain).
- `util/RiskFlags.java` (new) — `flagFor(owner)` OR-combining the three conditions.
- `OwnerEmail.java` — refactored to reuse `DisposableEmailDomains.isBlocked` instead of its own private copy of the list (removes duplication/drift).
- `mapper/OwnerMapper.java` — added the `riskFlag` expression mapping.
- `openapi.yml` — added the `riskFlag` read-only boolean to the `Owner` schema so the generated `OwnerDto` carries it.

`AcceptanceTest.coreRiskFlagFalseNormally` passes (a fully unique owner with no email → false), and the full suite is `BUILD SUCCESS`.
